errors.text_span: has a linear scale with tick labels at irregular intervals
errors.evidence: The x-axis is not a linear scale; the numerical values of the ticks are not spaced linearly (e.g., the gap between 0.9 and 1 is 0.1, while the gap between 1 and 2 is 1.0). It is better described as a categorical or non-uniform numerical axis.
The description claims the y-axis has no units, but the axis label is "Micro-F1 Score (%)", clearly indicating the unit is percentage.

errors.text_span: peaking at around 57.5% at lambda value 1
errors.evidence: The peak for the MatDetector line at lambda value 1 is significantly higher than 57.5%; it is approximately 57.8% or 57.9%, very close to the 58% gridline.

errors.text_span: declining to around 54% at lambda value 3
errors.evidence: The end value for the MatDetector line at lambda value 3 is visibly below the 54% gridline, at approximately 53.4%. Stating it is 'around 54%' is a notable overestimation.

errors.text_span: reaches a peak of around 55% at lambda value 0.7
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the peak for the ChemDataExtractor line. While there is a local peak at 0.7 (approx. 54.8%), the absolute peak for this line occurs at lambda value 1, with a score of approximately 55.2%.

Describing the end of the ChemDataExtractor line as 'stabilizing' is an interpretation. The plot shows a clear downward trend from lambda value 1 (approx. 55.2%) to 3 (approx. 54.1%); it is not leveling off or stabilizing.
